name: Project Trouble
desc: A project on $market has stopped, is losing ground, or has left fallout behind. Idle work crews, missed deliveries and poisoned air make the people restless.

name: Integrated Citizens
desc: The former decivilized settlements of $market now belong to the colony. Their kin and neighbors follow them in, and for a while the colony grows faster.

name: Water Delivered
desc: Comet water has just reached $market. The planet type changes at once.

name: Water Drawn Off
desc: Water has just been drawn off $market. The planet type changes at once.

name: Sparse Marine Life
desc: A few hardy kinds of fish and kelp live in the seas of $market, in patches far apart. Fishing crews bring home a catch, but a small one.

name: Thriving Marine Life
desc: Kelp forests and shoals of fish fill the shallow seas of $market. The food web holds together by itself, and the fishing crews bring home a steady catch.

name: Abundant Marine Life
desc: Reefs, kelp forests and great shoals of fish fill the seas of $market, from the sunlit shallows down to the deep trenches. Every fishing crew comes home with full nets.
